name: Arbitrade

runtime.secrets_policy: Set secrets in deployment environment; never commit .env, production credentials, or production database dumps.

note: External deployment platforms should read this manifest and BUILD_AND_RELEASE.md, then deploy only a merged, CI-passing main commit (or its immutable release tag).
